## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Rust formatting, Clippy, and tests pass.
- [ ] Affected Python, Node, or Web tests pass.
- [ ] Package/model consistency checks pass when relevant.
- [ ] New inference behavior is measured on positives and hard negatives.
- [ ] No benchmark images, annotations, models, credentials, or personal data are included.

## Compatibility

Describe schema, C ABI, package, model-cache, and device-provider impact. Write “none” when there is no impact.
